_comment: Unit archetypes. A UnitDefinition describes a class of soldier; a Soldier instance is a specific person of that class. Balance is deliberately rough - these numbers exist to make the loop work, and are expected to move. Costs are in gold.

units.name: Peasant Recruit
units.description: A farmer handed a spear and a leather cap. Cheap, willing, and unlikely to see next spring.

units.name: Spearman
units.description: A trained levy with a long spear and a shield. Nothing special in a brawl, but nothing gives ground either.

units.name: Archer
units.description: Kills from a distance and dies up close. Needs a line in front of him, and knows it.
